title: Inspect the logistic regression archive
description: You follow two fitted models and their test probabilities into one artifact.

steps.description: You create artifacts and begin logreg_run.npz. The archive stores gradient-descent and Newton weights with their optimization histories.
You include mu and sigma alongside test features and labels. These entries preserve scaling values and the test split.

steps.question: Do the two probability entries use the same test design matrix?
steps.answer: Both use Phi_te. The first uses w_gd and the second uses w_nt.

steps.description: You save both sets of test probabilities and list artifacts. The recorded directory contains logreg_run.npz.
